description: Synthetic Westbridge fixture; manually authored relevance, not verified real-airport policies.

chunks.text: Parking extension after a flight delay: use Manage Parking before the reservation ends. If the page rejects the extension, customer service can review the booking reference and revised arrival time. Do not assume the reservation is extended until confirmed.

Perpanjangan parkir karena penerbangan terlambat: buka Kelola Parkir sebelum reservasi berakhir. Jika halaman menolak perpanjangan, CS dapat memeriksa nomor booking dan waktu kedatangan terbaru. Reservasi belum diperpanjang sampai ada konfirmasi.

Missing lounge confirmation: the recorded purchaser can retrieve the confirmation from the booking page. If the guest is at reception and the reservation cannot be found, request customer service review using the lounge booking reference and purchaser email.

Konfirmasi lounge hilang: pemesan tercatat dapat mengambil konfirmasi dari halaman booking. Jika tamu sudah di resepsionis tetapi pesanan tidak ditemukan, minta pemeriksaan CS dengan nomor booking lounge dan email pemesan.

Payment marked pending after a bank debit: the assistant reads the recorded payment status and can submit a payment review with the booking reference, payment reference and approximate time. A bank debit alone does not change the service payment record.

Pembayaran masih pending setelah saldo bank terpotong: asisten membaca status tercatat dan dapat mengajukan pemeriksaan dengan nomor booking, referensi pembayaran dan perkiraan waktu. Saldo terpotong tidak langsung mengubah catatan pembayaran layanan.

Family pickup waiting: drivers waiting inside their cars should use the signed holding area before proceeding to the pickup lane. Visitors waiting on foot can use the public arrivals hall. The pickup lane is only for active boarding.

Menunggu penjemputan keluarga: pengemudi yang menunggu di mobil memakai area tunggu kendaraan sebelum menuju jalur jemput. Pengunjung yang menunggu dengan berjalan kaki dapat memakai aula kedatangan umum. Jalur jemput hanya untuk penumpang naik kendaraan.

Refund enquiry: customer service needs the booking reference, service name, reason for the request and verified contact email. The assistant may prepare a request after confirmation. The responsible provider decides eligibility and processes any refund.

Pertanyaan refund: CS memerlukan nomor booking, nama layanan, alasan permintaan dan email kontak terverifikasi. Asisten boleh menyiapkan pengajuan setelah konfirmasi. Penyedia terkait memutuskan kelayakan dan memproses pengembalian dana.

Language preference: customers can switch between English and Indonesian during a conversation. Existing booking references and case context remain attached. Switching language does not require opening a new request.
Pilihan bahasa: pelanggan boleh berganti antara bahasa Inggris dan Indonesia selama percakapan. Referensi booking dan konteks kasus tetap tersimpan. Pergantian bahasa tidak memerlukan pengajuan baru.

Case follow-up: after submitting a confirmed support request, the customer receives a case reference. Staff replies arrive by email and the customer can reply directly to that email. Returning to the portal is not required for the reply.

Tindak lanjut kasus: setelah pengajuan bantuan dikonfirmasi, pelanggan memperoleh nomor kasus. Balasan petugas masuk melalui email dan pelanggan dapat membalas email tersebut langsung. Pelanggan tidak perlu kembali ke portal untuk membalas.

Booking access for another person: access is granted only to a purchaser or representative already recorded in the source booking system and verified through the matching contact. Knowing a passenger name alone is insufficient. There is no delegation feature in this assistant.

Akses pesanan orang lain: akses hanya untuk pemesan atau perwakilan yang sudah tercatat di sistem booking sumber dan terverifikasi melalui kontak yang sesuai. Mengetahui nama penumpang saja tidak cukup. Asisten tidak memiliki fitur pemberian kuasa.

Possible duplicate charge: collect the booking reference and both payment references if available. Submit one case describing both entries for provider review. The assistant cannot reverse a charge or declare either entry refunded.

Dugaan tagihan ganda: kumpulkan nomor booking dan kedua referensi pembayaran bila tersedia. Ajukan satu kasus yang menjelaskan kedua catatan untuk pemeriksaan penyedia. Asisten tidak dapat membatalkan tagihan atau menyatakan dana sudah dikembalikan.

Closed case email replies: a simple thank-you does not reopen a closed case. To continue the same unresolved issue, explicitly request continuation of that issue. A different problem requires a new request with its own context.

Balasan email kasus closed: ucapan terima kasih saja tidak membuka ulang kasus. Untuk melanjutkan masalah sama yang belum selesai, minta kelanjutan masalah tersebut secara jelas. Masalah berbeda memerlukan pengajuan baru dengan konteks sendiri.
Lost property enquiries go to the airport lost property desk. Provide the approximate location, time and a description of the item. Do not include bank passwords or full payment card details.
Pertanyaan barang hilang ditujukan ke meja barang hilang bandara. Sediakan perkiraan lokasi, waktu dan deskripsi barang. Jangan sertakan kata sandi bank atau nomor kartu pembayaran lengkap.

Mobility assistance requests should describe the terminal, arrival time and type of assistance needed. Staff coordinate availability with the responsible service. A chat request is not a confirmed assistance booking.

Permintaan bantuan mobilitas menjelaskan terminal, waktu kedatangan dan jenis bantuan. Petugas mengoordinasikan ketersediaan dengan layanan terkait. Permintaan chat belum merupakan booking bantuan yang terkonfirmasi.
Parking entry problems: provide the reservation reference, entry time and barrier message. Customer service can route the case to parking support. Do not share a parking access code publicly.
Kendala masuk parkir: sediakan referensi reservasi, waktu masuk dan pesan pada palang. CS dapat meneruskan kasus ke bantuan parkir. Jangan membagikan kode akses parkir secara publik.
Lounge opening hours are listed on the lounge service information page. Check the terminal and intended visit date. Opening hours do not guarantee a seat or entry entitlement.
Jam buka lounge tercantum pada halaman informasi layanan lounge. Periksa terminal dan tanggal kunjungan. Jam buka tidak menjamin tempat duduk atau hak masuk.
Baggage storage information includes location, opening hours and prohibited items. The storage operator confirms acceptance at the counter. The assistant does not accept custody of luggage.
Informasi penitipan bagasi mencakup lokasi, jam buka dan barang terlarang. Operator penitipan memastikan penerimaan di konter. Asisten tidak menerima tanggung jawab penitipan bagasi.
Public Wi-Fi connection instructions are available on airport signs. Select the airport public network and follow the sign-in page. Airport support never asks for a bank login to connect.
Petunjuk Wi-Fi publik tersedia pada papan informasi bandara. Pilih jaringan publik bandara dan ikuti halaman masuk. Bantuan bandara tidak meminta login bank untuk menghubungkan Wi-Fi.
Terminal transfer information depends on the current terminal, destination terminal and whether the customer can enter public areas. Ask these questions before giving a route.
Informasi perpindahan terminal bergantung pada terminal awal, terminal tujuan dan apakah pelanggan boleh masuk area publik. Tanyakan hal ini sebelum memberikan rute.
For an immediate medical emergency, contact onsite emergency staff or the airport emergency point. Customer service chat is not the emergency response channel.
Untuk keadaan medis darurat, hubungi petugas darurat di lokasi atau titik bantuan darurat bandara. Chat layanan pelanggan bukan kanal respons darurat.

Receipt enquiries require a booking or payment reference and a verified contact. A receipt copy can only be retrieved from the responsible service records. It is separate from a request to refund the payment.

Permintaan kuitansi memerlukan referensi booking atau pembayaran dan kontak terverifikasi. Salinan kuitansi hanya dapat diambil dari catatan layanan terkait. Ini berbeda dari permintaan pengembalian pembayaran.
Customers may request a human customer service agent. If no agent is immediately available, confirm the email contact and offer a case for follow-up rather than promising instant chat availability.
Pelanggan boleh meminta petugas CS manusia. Jika petugas belum tersedia, konfirmasi email kontak dan tawarkan kasus untuk tindak lanjut, bukan menjanjikan chat langsung tersedia.
